steps.text: Raises virus resistance, the max dino level you can hit. Ease off once Lv.60 dinos are comfortable.

steps.title: Bio Greenhouses
steps.text: Passive Fern Leaves. 4 plots; the 5th unlocks with Wartime Investment. Keep them upgraded.

steps.title: Alliance Centers ×3

steps.title: Command Center
steps.text: Seasonal troop damage. Strong, not urgent. Start once Lab and Greenhouses are stable.

steps.title: Armory ×2 + Fortification ×2
steps.text: Troop ATK and DEF. Upgrade together; all attack and no defense loses troops.
